test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹240 in 3 years at 20% per year rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹240

Time (t) = 3 years

Rate of Interest (r) = 20% per year

**Formula used:**

SI = (P times r times t)/(100)

Where, P = Principal

**Calculations:**

240 = (P times 20 times 3)/(100)

⇒ P = (240 times 100)/(20 times 3)

⇒ P = (24000)/(60)

⇒ P = ₹400

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
